answer: The cheapest real defence: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because timber only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, vault is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any pulse approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
